Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: cinema
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A dark room with a projector screen and plenty of chairs. Guests buy a ticket for the next screening; a screening runs for as long as the film does and nobody gets a refund for falling asleep. Needs a powered projector screen and at least a few seats in front of it.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: beauty salon
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A room with salon chairs. Guests pay for a haircut, a new style, a dye job or, with the right ideology, a tattoo; a colonist with the serving work type does the work. Without anyone to serve, the salon is closed.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: gallery
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A room full of sculptures, hung in good light. Guests pay a small entry fee and walk past the pieces one by one; the more beautiful the art, the happier they leave. Needs a handful of artworks in the room.
